tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rta mgrin snying thig snying po don sbyor las/ smin byed bsdus pa gtor ma'i dbang bskur gyi cho ga dbang chen grub pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang rta mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// ha hā shes rab rta skad gsum// hi hī bde chen dbyangs su 'tsher// sa gsum 'gro ba zil gnon pa'i// dbang chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// smin byed spros pa'i chu klung kun// gcig dril byin rlabs chu mtsho'i bcud// gtor dbang yid bzhin nor bu yi// lag len bklag chog bkod par bya// 'di la sbyor ba gnas khang rgyan gyis spras shing rten bkram pa'i gung du stegs bu la dkyil 'khor ras bris yod na bkram/ med na maṇḍal la tshom bu lha grangs bkod pa'i steng du khri'u la rin po che'i thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du dpal gtor pad spungs nor bu 'bar ba ni/ 'og tu gdan maṇḍal sbub pa lta bu brtsegs ma bya/ 'og mar padma phyir bstan grangs med kyis bskor/ steng ma la pad khug rtse mo can brgyad kyis bskor ba'i mtshams rnams su thod skam ltag pa nang du bstan pa re re bzhag /de'i steng du zan zlum po'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de steng zan zlum po'i gdong la mar gyi dung phreng bsgrigs pa'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de steng chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i steng du dpal gtor snying la zur gtod pa 'dra ba/ logs gsum la chos 'byung gru gsum la thod skam ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum res spras pa/ rtse mo la rta zhal phag zhal/ nyi zla nor bu 'bar ba'i rgyan dang bcas pa/ zur du dkar thig /gshong rnams su dmar rgyan gyis spras pa la spod dang zas snas bskor te bsham/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka /nyer spyod phreng tshar/ gtor tshogs/ las bum sogs mkho ba'i yo byad 'du bya/ dngos gzhi la brgyud 'debs sngon gtor nas brtsam las byang ltar gzhung bsrang*/ bsdu na bdag bskyed kho na'i tshig gis bdag dang gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor lhan cig gsal btab/ rgyas par spro na bdag bskyed lus dkyil sngon du 'gro bas gtor ma phyi dkyil mdun bskyed skabs ltar rgyas par bskyed nas/

spyan 'dren mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar du btang zhing bdag mdun gnyis kar spro bsdu dang mthar gtor 'bul bya/ las bum du rdor sems bskyed bzlas dang gter srung gtor 'bul/ 'grub na tshogs mchod bsgral bstab kyi bar du byas la rig pa'i me tog dor cing gnang ba nod par bya'o/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus bya/ bgegs gtor btang zhing bka' bsgo mtshams gcod las byang ltar grub nas/ me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de la 'dir dbang chen padma rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs bye ba phrag brgya'i yang snying rdzogs chen yang gsang snying po'i gdams pa dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje sems dpas rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje la bstsal cing des slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la rjes su gdams pa/ de nyid kyis mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang a tsa ra sā le'i yang srid grub chen chos blo mgon po la thugs dam gyi bcud du bstsal cing nyang po brag dkar lha chur phyi rabs kyi don du rim pa bdun gyi rgyas btab pa/ de nyid kyi skye ba grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen po rig 'dzin mchog ldan rdo rje'am las rab zhig po gling pas zab mo'i gter sgo dbye bar mdzad pa rta mgrin snying po don sbyor las/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur bsdus pa gtor dbang yid bzhin nor bu bar chad kun sel nyid bsgrub par bgyi ba la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug / de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ji ltar rdo rje 'chang chen gyis: rdo rje sems dpa' byin brlabs ltar: deng 'dir slob dpon khyed nyid kyis: bar chad kun sel gtor ma'i dbang: thugs rje'i gter gyis bstsal du gsol: lan gsum brjod/ slob dpon dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor la rtsa gsum chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: sogs lan gsum/ de nas yid gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin gsal 'debs par zhu/ gtor snod mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba gur dang bla bre ye shes kyi me ri me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du: thod pa brtsegs pa'i ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i phyi rol dur khrod brgyad: nang ka ba brgyad kyis btegs pa'i dbus su: gtor ma sha lnga sman lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu: de yongs su gyur pa las: skad cig gis dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis: rdo rje dang thod pa bsnams shing yum la 'khyud pa: rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa: spyi gtsug tu rta mgo ljang zhur 'tsher ba: de'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo: sku mdog mthing gsal du 'bar ba: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa: khro gnyer gru gsum dpral ba'i dbus su bsdus pa: dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'bar ba: spyi gtsug tu phag zhal mthing ga ngur sgra sgrog pa: g.yas pas gri gug thogs nas yab la 'khyud pa: g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob pa: zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i tshul gyis yab la 'khril ba: rus pa'i rgyan dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa: snang stong thabs shes dbyer med pa'i phyir: snying rje chen po'i ngang las bde stong zung 'jug tu kha sbyor ba: ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par mos mdzod: de'i spyi gtsug tu padma dang zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du: rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma kun 'dus longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rang bzhin: padma 'byung gnas rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can: sku mdog mthing gsal rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa: rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba'i bar na yum rdo rje phag mo gcer bu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa:

gnyis ka'ang rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa: rdo rje'i skyil krung mdzad pa'i snying gar zhi ba'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang: spyi bo dung khang du khro bo'i lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad: 'ja' tshon ltar 'od du gsal ba: de la 'khor dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa: lha tshogs de rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phros: khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas: lus kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag: spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob: lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod cig: sha chen dang spos dud rol mo'i sgra sbyar/ gtor chen spyi bor bzhag la/ kun bzang yab yum zhi khro yab yum dang: rdo rje 'chang chen ston pa rdo rje sems: dga' rab rdo rje padma yab yum sogs: rje gong ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs: brgyud pa 'dzin la byin gyis rlobs: rje bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum: mi 'bral spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs: bzhugs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: oṃ: dam rdzas gtor mas dbang bskur bas: sku'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs: lus kyi sgrib pa dag nas kyang: lus spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī hrīḥm ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa tsitta sa ma ya hring hring dzaḥdza: lha tshogs rnams kyi gsung las 'od zer dmar po 'phros: khyed rang rnams kyi ngag la phog: ngag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag: gsang ba'i dbang thob: lam rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod: spos rol bcas gtor ma mgrin par bzhag la/ kun bzang yab yum sogs shlo ka gnyis kyi mthar/ ā: dam rdzas gtor mas dbang bskur bas: gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs: ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas kyang: longs sku gsang ba'i dbang thob shog: ces dang sngags gong ltar brjod/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs las 'od zer sngon po 'phros: khyed rang rnams kyi sems la phog:

sems kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag: shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob: lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod: spos rol bcas gtor ma snying gar bzhag la/ kun bzang yab yum sogs gong bzhin gyi mthar/ hūm̐: dam rdzas gtor mas dbang bskur bas: thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la zhugs: sems kyi sgrib pa dag nas kyang: shes rab ye shes dbang thob shog: ces dang sngags brjod/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pas: khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phog: sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob: 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du gyur pa rdo rje 'chang gi sa la dbang thob par mos shig: spos rol bcas gtor chen gnas gsum du bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dam rdzas gtor mas dbang bskur bas: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag nas kyang: tshig dbang rin chen dbang thob shog: ces dang sngags brjod do// de dag gis sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs dang bcas pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa song nas/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis dpal rta mgrin dpa' bo gcig pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams nas yum la 'khyud pa: yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa bsnams nas yab la 'khyud pa: yab yum gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan dang: dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa: de'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas: ye shes pa'i lha dang bla ma brgyud pa thams cad byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim par mos shig: slar yang gtor chen spyi bor bzhag la/

hūm̐: rje yid bzhin nor bu gtsug gi rgyan: brgyud ldan bla ma rnams kyi dbang bskur bas: man ngag snying la zhugs par byin gyis rlobs: chos sku bde chen nam mkha'i mdzod: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rnams kyis dbang bskur bas: ngo bo ka nas dag par byin gyis rlobs: longs sku mtshan dpes rab tu brgyan: rig 'dzin brda brgyud rnams kyis dbang bskur bas: rig pa sku ru smin par byin gyis rlobs: sprul sku ci yang 'gro ba'i dpal: gang zag snyan khung brgyud pas dbang bskur bas: snang sems 'dzin pa dag par byin gyis rlobs: ci bsam phrin las thogs pa med: mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i brgyud pas dbang bskur bas: rgyal ba'i bka' gnang thob par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes bstim mo// de nas rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa yin pas khyed rang rnams kyis gtor chen gyi snod la 'jus la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob ma gtor snod 'jur bcug la/ bcom ldan dbang chen bdag la bstsal lags kyis: bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol: lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan dbang chen 'di la bstsal lags kyis: 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol: lan gsum brjod/ gtor ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dngos su gsal ba spyi bor byon/ thugs rje byin rlabs kyi ngo bo khro chung mtshon cha me phung 'od zer gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum la gnod par byed pa'i nad gdon bar chad thams cad tshar bcad par mos shig /hrī: bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis: steng phyogs lha yi gdug pa zlog: yi dam rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis: bar gdon gnyan gyi gdug pa zlog: mkha' 'gro rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis: 'og phyogs klu yi gdug pa zlog: chos skyong rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis: ban byad bon byad lha 'dre'i sdang byad ngan pa zlog:

bka' srung rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis: lo kag zla kag zhag kag ngan pa zlog: ces brjod la gtor chen mgo thog bzhag / de nas rtsa ba gsum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi klong du khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum sbas pas phyin chad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed par mos shig / slar yang gtor chen gnas gsum du bzhag la/ hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi: 'gyur ba med pa sku yi rgya: slob ma'i lus 'di bsrung du gsol: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi: 'gag pa med pa gsung gi rgya: slob ma'i ngag la bsrung du gsol: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi: 'khrul pa med pa thugs kyi rgya: slob ma 'di yi sems la bsrung du gsol: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yis: slob ma 'di yi lus ngag yid gsum sbos: tshe 'di sbos la srog 'di skyobs: tshe yang rab tu brtan gyur cig: srog kyang rab tu sra gyur cig: tshe yo ba yod na bsrang du gsol: tshe nyams pa yod na gso ru gsol: tshe ma grub pa yod na bsgrub tu gsol: tshe gas pa yod na sbyar du gsol: chad pa yod na mthud du gsol: tshe mi 'gyur thugs kyi dkyil du zungs: mtha' rten du rgyas btab pas rdo rje ye shes chen po'i srung ba'i gur khang nang du tshud nas cis kyang mi shigs mi 'gyur bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor rgyan mar spyi bor byugs la/ gcig pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa dkon mchog gsum gyi rgya: bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rgya: drug pa dpal chen rta mgrin rgya: bdun pa gser gyi zo ris rgya: rgya rim pa bdun gyi rgyas btab bo: oṃ buddha ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐: badzra ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐: ratna ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐: padma ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐: karma ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐: lo ka ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐:

oṃ bhrūm̐ āḥbhrūm̐ hūm̐ bhrūm̐ tshe bhrūm̐: oṃ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī ha ya grī ba ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa shūn+ya tā ma hā rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐: zhes rgyas btab/ gtor ma'i lha 'od du zhu nas dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil pa la longs spyod pas mchog dang thun mong ma lus stan thog 'di nyid du thob par mos shig / gtor ma'i cha shas bdud rtsi bsres pa byin la/ kā ya siddhi oṃ: wā ka siddhi ā: tsitta siddhi hūm̐: sarba siddhi hrī: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: ces dang shis brjod ji ltar 'os pa bya'o// de dag gis rta mgrin snying thig snying po don gyi sbyor ba'i byin rlabs gtor dbang zab mo legs par grub pa yin pas sogs kyis dam tshig khas blangs pa man chad dbang gi rjes rim dang*/ tshogs yod na rol zhing lhag ma gtang ba phyin dang*/ med na mchod bstod nongs bshags sogs las byang gi rjes chog ltar rdzogs par bya'o// gtor mas phrin las kun 'grub phyir// sngags 'chang kun gyi snying gi nor// 'dis sngags tshul bzhin spyod 'dod kun// rnam pa kun tu dbugs dbyung shog /ces pa'ang zab chos 'di nyid kyi zhabs tog tu dmigs nas blo gros dman pa 'jug bde'i slad nag 'gros su bsdebs pa po padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sde'o// dge legs 'phel////
